# Freelance Data Cleaning Deliverable Planner

## Purpose
Defines a safe, auditable data-cleaning engagement with measurable before-and-after quality checks.

## Workflow
1. Confirm file types, data ownership, allowed fields, intended use, and retention rules.
2. Profile only synthetic or client-approved minimized samples.
3. Define normalization, duplicate handling, missing-value policy, validation constraints, exception review, and reversible transformations.
4. Establish row counts and quality metrics before work.
5. Specify delivery formats and acceptance tests.

## Output
Statement of work, transformation rules, data-quality baseline, exception log template, and acceptance checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Do not upload client data to unapproved services or silently discard records. Protect personal data and preserve source copies. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
